note: The one subscribe route for Make Your Mind Up (audit 2026-11-14, I-09). engine/route.py, engine/intensity.py, engine/subscribe_gate.py and engine/run/ga4.py must equal it (tests/test_subscribe_route_spec.py). Other repositories vendor this file with its sha256 and build every subscribe link from it; change it here first, then in the code, in one pull request.
utm_content_rule: lower case, unique to the post and its channel. A post that is a publish-board item: content_of(<board item id> + '-' + <channel>), for example engine:2026-11-09:gitbroke on threads is engine-2026-11-09-gitbroke-threads (engine/route.py item_content; Control Center binds a sent post to its item by this, exact only, never a prefix). Any other post: its slot or post id through content_of.
sources_rule: Each key is a pinned channel and the utm_source a new link is built with; its list is every utm_source the subscribe gate accepts for that channel (Buffer's own service name included).
content_of: lower case; each run of characters outside a-z, 0-9, _ and - becomes one -; no leading - or _; at most 64 (engine/route.py content_of)
